name: Bendiks H. Arnesen
detail: Former Storting representative for Arbeiderpartiet (Troms) 1989-2013; voted in Roll Call 2354 on 29 May 2012; died 13 November 2024.

name: Gunnar Molnes
detail: Journalist and fact-checker at Faktisk.no. His 2020 fact-check, cited in a Manifest Analyse note, reports that abolishing the wealth tax would create over 25,000 zero-taxpayers; a fact-check is not a statement of support, and the register row quoted a bibliographic citation, not his words.
